name: Functional Benefics, Malefics and Yogakarakas by Ascendant
note: Lordship-based (functional) nature of the planets for each of the 12 ascendants, as given in BPHS chapter 34 (Yogakarakadhyaya), verses 19-44, plus the general rules of verses 2-18. This fills the KNOWLEDGE_GAPS.md item 'classical list of functional benefics and malefics per ascendant'; remedy_plan.py currently derives this from house lordship alone. The maraka ('killer') designations BPHS also gives per ascendant are deliberately NOT included: they are longevity/death indicators and the app excludes lifespan predictions (README v1.2). Where BPHS gives no label for a planet, the field is left empty rather than inferred. Translations differ slightly between editions (e.g. Santhanam vs. Sharma); the lists below follow the Santhanam-based English rendering.

general_rules.rule: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, the Moon) lose their beneficence when they own only a kendra (1/4/7/10); natural malefics owning a kendra lose their maleficence. Neither becomes the opposite - they become neutral (Kendradhipati dosha).

Lords of trikonas (1, 5, 9) always give auspicious results; the lagna lord is especially auspicious because the 1st is both kendra and trikona. The 5th and 9th are 'specially for wealth'; the 7th and 10th 'specially for happiness'.
Lords of the 3rd, 6th and 11th (trishadaya) give evil results, increasing in that order (11th strongest).

Lords of the 2nd and 12th give results according to their association (neutral on their own). The 8th lord is inauspicious (12th from the 9th), worse if it also owns the 3rd, 7th or 11th, but becomes auspicious if it also owns a trikona. The Sun and Moon do not suffer the blemish of 8th lordship.

Within each group strength rises in order: among kendras the 10th is strongest, among trikonas the 9th, among trishadayas the 11th. A planet owning a stronger house overrides the result of the weaker house it also owns.
A planet owning both a kendra and a trikona is a Yogakaraka by itself; it is especially strong when it also sits in a kendra or trikona.
Kendra-trikona lords form Raja Yoga by exchange, conjunction, mutual aspect, or one sitting in the other's house - but not if either also owns a dusthana (6/8/12) by that relation alone.

Rahu and Ketu give results mainly through the lord they are joined with and the house they occupy; in a kendra or trikona and connected (by conjunction or aspect) with a kendra or trikona lord they act as Yogakarakas.

Natural nature: Jupiter and Venus are benefics, the Moon is mildly benefic, Mercury takes the nature of what it joins; the Sun, Saturn and Mars are malefics. Full Moon, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus rise in beneficence in that order; weak Moon, Sun, Saturn, Mars rise in maleficence in that order.

verification_pass.method: Per-ascendant lists taken from an English rendering of BPHS ch.34 (barbarapijan.com, Santhanam-based) and cross-checked against the Sanskrit verses 35 and 43 (enjoylearningsanskrit.com) and Sarajit Poddar's SJC translation notes.
verification_pass.unchanged_after_verification: Scorpio (v.35: Venus, Mercury, Saturn malefic; Jupiter, Moon benefic; Sun and Moon yogakaraka) and Pisces (v.43: Saturn, Venus, Sun, Mercury malefic; Mars, Moon benefic; Mars and Jupiter yoga-giving) match the Sanskrit exactly.

items.notes: Mars (lagna and 8th lord) helps the auspicious planets. Saturn with Jupiter does not give yoga.
items.summary: For Aries rising, Jupiter (9th lord) and the Sun (5th lord) are the reliable helpers; Saturn, Mercury and Venus are difficult.

items.notes: Saturn (9th and 10th lord) alone causes Raja Yoga. Mercury is somewhat inauspicious.
items.summary: For Taurus rising, Saturn is the yogakaraka and the Sun also helps; Jupiter, the Moon and (as lagna lord owning the 6th) Venus are difficult.

items.notes: BPHS calls Venus (5th and 12th lord) the only auspicious planet for Gemini.
items.summary: For Gemini rising, Venus (5th lord) is the one clear helper; Mars, Jupiter and the Sun are difficult.

items.notes: Mars (5th and 10th lord) gives a full-fledged yoga by itself.
items.summary: For Cancer rising, Mars is the yogakaraka, supported by Jupiter and the Moon; Venus and Mercury are difficult.

items.notes: Mars (4th and 9th lord) is widely treated as the yogakaraka for Leo by later authors; BPHS lists it among the auspicious planets. Jupiter joined with Venus does not give good results.
items.summary: For Leo rising, Mars, Jupiter and the Sun help; Mercury, Venus and Saturn are difficult.

items.notes: Venus joined with Mercury produces yoga. The Sun's results depend on its association.
items.summary: For Virgo rising, Mercury and Venus help (together they give yoga); Mars, Jupiter and the Moon are difficult.

items.notes: BPHS: the Moon (10th lord) and Mercury (9th lord) together cause Raja Yoga. Saturn (4th and 5th lord) also owns a kendra and a trikona, so by the general rule FN-R6 it is a yogakaraka on its own, which is how most later authors treat it.
items.summary: For Libra rising, Saturn and Mercury help, and the Moon with Mercury gives Raja Yoga; Jupiter, the Sun and Mars are difficult.

items.notes: BPHS names both the Sun (10th lord) and the Moon (9th lord) as yogakarakas for Scorpio.
items.summary: For Scorpio rising, the Sun and Moon are yogakarakas and Jupiter helps; Venus, Mercury and Saturn are difficult.

items.notes: Venus is the only inauspicious planet. The Sun (9th lord) and Mercury (7th and 10th lord) together are capable of conferring a yoga.
items.summary: For Sagittarius rising, Mars and the Sun help, and the Sun with Mercury gives yoga; Venus is the one difficult planet.

items.notes: Only Venus (5th and 10th lord) causes a superior yoga.
items.summary: For Capricorn rising, Venus is the yogakaraka and Mercury helps; Mars, Jupiter and the Moon are difficult.

items.notes: Venus (4th and 9th lord) is the only planet that causes Raja Yoga. Mercury gives mixed ('meddling') results.
items.summary: For Aquarius rising, Venus is the yogakaraka and Saturn helps; Jupiter, the Moon and Mars are difficult.

items.notes: Mars (2nd and 9th lord) and Jupiter (lagna and 10th lord) together cause a yoga.
items.summary: For Pisces rising, Mars and the Moon help and Mars with Jupiter gives yoga; Saturn, Venus, the Sun and Mercury are difficult.
